description: This file implements a WebSocket client API for the Zephyr RTOS, including connection management, message sending/receiving, and internal context handling.

methods.name: websocket_context_ref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a websocket context.

methods.name: websocket_context_unref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a websocket context and frees if zero.

methods.name: websocket_context_is_used
methods.description: Checks if a websocket context is currently in use based on refcount.

methods.name: websocket_get
methods.description: Retrieves an unused websocket context from the pool.

methods.name: websocket_find
methods.description: Finds a websocket context by its associated socket.

methods.name: response_cb
methods.description: HTTP response callback to handle partial and final data reception.

methods.name: on_header_field
methods.description: HTTP header field parser callback to detect 'Sec-WebSocket-Accept'.

methods.name: on_header_value
methods.description: HTTP header value parser callback to verify WebSocket handshake.

methods.name: websocket_connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection, performs handshake, and sets up context.

methods.name: websocket_disconnect
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: websocket_interal_disconnect
methods.description: Sends close frame and unrefs context to disconnect.

methods.name: websocket_close_vmeth
methods.description: Virtual method to close WebSocket via context.

methods.name: websocket_poll_offload
methods.description: Handles poll offloading for WebSocket socket.

methods.name: websocket_ioctl_vmeth
methods.description: IOCTL handler for WebSocket context.

methods.name: sendmsg_all
methods.description: Sends entire msghdr over socket, handling partial sends.

methods.name: websocket_prepare_and_send
methods.description: Prepares WebSocket frame headers and sends message.

methods.name: websocket_send_msg
methods.description: Sends a WebSocket message with specified opcode and masking.

methods.name: websocket_opcode2flag
methods.description: Converts opcode to internal message type flag.

methods.name: websocket_parse
methods.description: Parses incoming WebSocket frames from buffer.

methods.name: wait_rx
methods.description: Waits for socket to be ready for reading with timeout.

methods.name: websocket_recv_msg
methods.description: Receives a WebSocket message, handling fragmentation and masking.

methods.name: websocket_send
methods.description: Sends data over WebSocket context.

methods.name: websocket_recv
methods.description: Receives data over WebSocket context.

methods.name: websocket_read_vmeth
methods.description: Virtual method for reading from WebSocket.

methods.name: websocket_write_vmeth
methods.description: Virtual method for writing to WebSocket.

methods.name: websocket_sendto_ctx
methods.description: Sendto implementation for WebSocket.

methods.name: websocket_recvfrom_ctx
methods.description: Recvfrom implementation for WebSocket.

methods.name: websocket_context_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all active WebSocket contexts and applies callback.

methods.name: websocket_init
methods.description: Initializes WebSocket subsystem, including context pool lock.
